post.summary:
Issues the client's mTLS and document-signing certificates from two certificate signing requests (CSRs).
This is the only BankConnect call that does not require an mTLS client certificate; it is authorized
by the enrollment token from the bank-issued enrollment file instead.
post.description:
Enrollment process:
            
1. The bank generates a password-protected enrollment file and shares it (and the password, separately)
   with the client. The file contains the `enrollmentId`, `clientApplicationId`, environment, CSR upload URL
   and a time-limited enrollment token bound to that `enrollmentId`.
2. The client generates two key pairs and CSRs locally. The private keys never leave the client's systems.
   - mTLS client CSR: RSA (3072–8192 bits, exponent 65537) or ECDSA (P-256/P-384).
   - Document-signing CSR: RSA only (3072–8192 bits, exponent 65537).
3. The client calls this endpoint with the enrollment token as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`,
   the `enrollmentId` as a query parameter and both PEM-encoded CSRs in the body.
   `environment` must match the environment of the API being called (e.g. `Production`, `Testing`).
4. The API returns both issued certificates as PEM. The client combines each certificate with the
   matching private key: the mTLS certificate is presented on every TLS connection, and the signing
   certificate is used to sign ISO 20022 business messages (e.g. pain.001).

parameters.name: enrollmentId
parameters.description: The enrollment identifier from the enrollment file. Must match the subject of the enrollment token.

requestBody.description: Client application ID, environment and the PEM-encoded mTLS and document-signing CSRs.

schema.description: Defines the request used to upload the QWAC and QSEAL certificate signing requests.

200.description: Certificates issued. Combine each certificate with the private key of the matching CSR.

schema.description: Defines the response returned after uploading the MTLS and QSEAL certificate signing requests.

400.description: A required value is missing or has an invalid format. An absent field, query parameter or Authorization header is rejected with a validation problem; an empty value or an invalid clientApplicationId is reported only after the enrollment token has been accepted.

empty-value.value: Signing certificate signing request is missing.

invalid-client-id.summary: clientApplicationId is not a positive integer

validation.summary: A required field, query parameter or header is absent

value.title: One or more validation errors occurred.

401.description: The enrollment token is malformed, expired, or was not issued for this enrollmentId. The token is checked before the request body is validated.

missing.summary: Authorization header is not a Bearer token

422.description: A CSR could not be processed (malformed PEM, unsupported algorithm or key size).

invalid-csr.value: Invalid certificate signing request. ASN1 corrupted data.

get.summary:
Returns the next outgoing message for the calling client application, i.e. the oldest message
whose row version is greater than the supplied `Row-Version` cursor.
get.description:
The client application is identified by its mTLS client certificate.
            
Messages are pain.002.001.10 payment status reports for previously submitted pain.001 payments,
wrapped in a signed `BusinessMessage` envelope (bcon.002.001.01) together with a Business Application Header.
The bank signs every message; verify the signature with the bank's signing certificate before trusting the content.
            
Polling process:
            
1. Call `GET /messages/next`, sending the last row version you processed in the `Row-Version` header.
   Omit the header on the very first call to start from the beginning of the queue.
2. On `200 OK`, durably process the message and store the `Row-Version` response header value.
   The same value is also contained in `AppHdr/BizMsgIdr` as `{BIC}-{rowVersion}`.
3. Confirm the message with `POST /messages/confirm/{rowVersion}` and poll again with the new cursor.
4. On `204 No Content` there are no more messages; wait before polling again.
            
Messages are not removed by this call. Until they are confirmed, polling with an older cursor
(or without the header) returns them again.

parameters.name: Row-Version
parameters.description: The row version of the last message already processed by the client. Omit to start from the beginning of the queue.

200.description: The next outgoing message. Store the Row-Version header and confirm the message after processing it.

Row-Version.description: Row version of the returned message. Send it as the Row-Version request header on the next poll and use it as {messageId} when confirming.

204.description: No message newer than the supplied Row-Version is waiting. Poll again later.

Row-Version.description: The unchanged cursor (the supplied Row-Version, or 0000000000000000 if none was sent).

500.description: An unexpected error occurred. Retry the request.

post.summary: Confirms delivery of outgoing messages and removes them from the client's queue.
post.description:
Confirmation is cumulative: every message of the calling client application with a row version
less than or equal to `messageId` is deleted, not only the message with that exact row version.
Confirm only after the message, and all earlier ones, have been durably processed.
            
Confirming is idempotent. Repeating it with the same or an older row version succeeds and deletes nothing more.

parameters.name: messageId
parameters.description: The `Row-Version` value returned with the last processed message.

200.description: All messages up to and including the given row version were removed from the queue.

500.description: An unexpected error occurred. Retry the request.

post.summary:
Creates an RTGS credit transfer from an ISO 20022 pain.001.001.09 message.
The request must be provided as signed XML and contain both the Business Application Header
and the payment initiation document. The message signature is validated before the transfer
is submitted for processing.

requestBody.description: ISO 20022 BankConnect Business Message (bc.001.001.01). For more details and XSD please check out: https://altasoft.github.io/geo-iso20022/
